messages:
amira: @channel FYI — SDK v4.1 will GA next Tuesday. Two coordinated changes: (A) client telemetry moves to explicit opt-in, and (B) we are removing support for the legacy ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json in favor of a per-process --runtime-config flag and REDWOOD_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH. Full migration guide: https://go.redwood/docs/sdk-v4-1-migration :loudspeaker:
noah: High level customer impact? break anything for hosted API customers?
jen: Hosted server-side telemetry is unchanged. Impact is limited to customers who depended on the local flags file or implicit client telemetry. We will implement a 30-day grace period where the SDK logs a clear deprecation warning but continues to read the legacy file; after that it will be ignored. Client telemetry will be disabled by default on GA.
ops: Ops action: Dedicated/Private fleets that inject ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json via config-management must switch to mounting a file at REDWOOD_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH or pass --runtime-config at process start. Weve added a converter in the management console to help translate common keys.
docs-bot: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 includes migration checklist, helm snippets, and mobile examples. Please review the mobile section.
cs: Need a customer-facing blurb + CSM FAQ with an impact list for Dedicated/Private customers.
amira: Comms plan: day 0 internal announce + release notes; day 2 targeted email to Dedicated/Private; day 7 GA + Console banner; day 14 reminder + migration metrics. Ill publish CSM FAQ and exec blurb by EOD.
release-bot: Build published: v4.1.0-rc2 (sha: a1b2c3d). Integration tests running.
jen: DevEx please update quickstarts and sdk-init templates to show explicit telemetry opt-in examples (Node, Python, and mobile).
noah: Will coordinate with DevEx. If the compatibility job flags anything, escalate to me and Amira. :thumbsup:
